perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: September 18 FDA full approval of Inluriyo plus Verzenio remains the freshest realized primary regulatory signal; Lilly also completed the AtaiBeckley acquisition September 11, adding a clinical-stage neuroscience option rather than realized earnings.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Regulatory conversion broadens oncology execution while AtaiBeckley adds pipeline optionality; neither acquisition potential nor early product adoption should be treated as durable revenue before commercial/clinical evidence arrives.
